facts.text: Hit arcades in March 1997, the first game on Namco's System 12 board, a step up from Tekken 2's System 11.
Set 19 years after Tekken 2. Most of the cast is new, led by Jin Kazama, son of Kazuya and Jun.
It introduced the sidestep: tap up or down to step into or out of the screen. Tekken became truly 3D here.
Jumps are lower than in Tekken 2, so you can't hop over every low attack. Sidestep instead.
Katsuhiro Harada, later the face of Tekken, co-directed. Every fighter's moves were motion-captured.
Its slower, big-beat soundtrack was new for Tekken. Harada was sceptical until composer Nobuyoshi Sano won him over.
About 35,000 cabinets sold in 1997, and it was Japan's top-grossing arcade game of 1998.
1 and 2 are left and right punch, 3 and 4 the kicks. Learn one fast jab, one mid attack and one punish first.
Gon the dinosaur, Dr. Bosconovitch and Tekken Ball are PlayStation-only. This is the pure arcade original.
